verdict.rationale: Browser Use documents a clear captcha stance. Automatic CAPTCHA solving is on by default for every Cloud browser and V4 agent run, and there is an explicit human fallback: open the live preview to take control if a challenge remains. Missing for 10: a list of which CAPTCHA types count as "supported", a documented captcha stance for the open-source local library, and independent or hands-on corroboration that solving works.
